llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了增材制造多孔钛植入体的孔径对骨长入的影响，与用户的生物医学植入体研究方向高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include stress shielding analysis, fatigue testing, or surface roughness characterization; it focuses on bone ingrowth without mechanical property evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究增材制造多孔钛植入体最佳孔径以促进骨长入
summary_zh.method: 通过增材制造制备不同孔径的多孔钛，植入动物体内进行实验
summary_zh.result: 较大孔径（500-1000微米）更有利于骨组织长入
summary_zh.validation: 动物体内实验验证骨长入效果

summary_en.motivation: To optimize pore size for enhanced bone ingrowth in additively manufactured porous titanium implants.
summary_en.method: Porous titanium scaffolds with varying pore sizes were fabricated by electron beam melting and implanted in a sheep model.
summary_en.result: Pore sizes between 500 and 1000 μm promoted significantly greater bone ingrowth compared to smaller pores.
summary_en.validation: In vivo animal experiment with histological analysis of bone ingrowth.

papers.title: The influence of printing parameters on cell survival rate and printability in microextrusion-based 3D cell printing technology
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) cell printing technology has provided a versatile methodology to fabricate cell-laden tissue-like constructs and in vitro tissue/pathological models for tissue engineering, drug testing and screening applications. However, it still remains a challenge to print bioinks with high viscoelasticity to achieve long-term stable structure and maintain high cell survival rate after printing at the same time. In this study, we systematically investigated the influence of 3D cell printing parameters, i.e. composition and concentration of bioink, holding temperature and holding time, on the printability and cell survival rate in microextrusion-based 3D cell printing technology. Rheological measurements were utilized to characterize the viscoelasticity of gelatin-based bioinks. Results demonstrated that the bioink viscoelasticity was increased when increasing the bioink concentration, increasing holding time and decreasing holding temperature below gelation temperature. The decline of cell survival rate after 3D cell printing process was observed when increasing the viscoelasticity of the gelatin-based bioinks. However, different process parameter combinations would result in the similar rheological characteristics and thus showed similar cell survival rate after 3D bioprinting process. On the other hand, bioink viscoelasticity should also reach a certain point to ensure good printability and shape fidelity. At last, we proposed a protocol for 3D bioprinting of temperature-sensitive gelatin-based hydrogel bioinks with both high cell survival rate and good printability. This research would be useful for biofabrication researchers to adjust the 3D bioprinting process parameters quickly and as a referable template for designing new bioinks.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了生物打印参数对细胞存活率和可打印性的影响，但未涉及AI/ML方法，与AI驱动生物打印方向关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is purely experimental parameter optimization without autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高粘弹性生物墨水在打印中维持结构稳定和高细胞存活率的矛盾。
summary_zh.method: 系统研究生物墨水成分、浓度、保温温度和时间对可打印性和细胞存活率的影响。
summary_zh.result: 增加生物墨水粘弹性会降低细胞存活率，但需保证一定粘弹性以维持形状保真度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过流变学测量和细胞存活实验验证参数影响。

summary_en.motivation: To address the trade-off between achieving long-term stable structures and maintaining high cell survival rates in 3D bioprinting.
summary_en.method: Systematically investigated the effects of bioink composition, concentration, holding temperature, and holding time on printability and cell viability.
summary_en.result: Increased bioink viscoelasticity reduced cell survival rates but was necessary for adequate shape fidelity.
summary_en.validation: Rheological measurements and cell viability assays were used to validate the parameter effects.
